memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "He had a dream in which he saw a stairway resting on the earth, with its top reaching to heaven, and the angels of God were ascending and descending on it." - Gen 28:12 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
In his dream, Jacob sees a stairway set on the earth, its top reaching all the way to heaven, with angels of God going up and down upon it. It is a breathtaking picture: heaven and earth connected, and movement passing between them. The distant God is not shut away in the sky; there is a living link between His dwelling and ours.

For centuries people wondered about the deeper meaning of this stairway. Then Jesus revealed it. Speaking to Nathanael, He said, "you will see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man" (John 1:51). Jesus was telling us that He Himself is the true stairway — the one and only connection between heaven and earth.

Think of what this means. We do not have to build our own way up to God through good works or religious effort. God has provided the stairway. Jesus is the bridge between a holy heaven and our broken earth, the one Mediator between God and humanity (1 Tim 2:5), the Way to the Father (John 14:6).

Jacob stumbled upon this promise in a dream. We hold it in fullness in Christ. Heaven is not closed to us; through Jesus, the way is open. Come to God through Him, and find the stairway already in place.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Am I trying to build my own way to God, or trusting the stairway He provided?
2. What does it mean to me that Jesus is the bridge between heaven and earth?
3. How does an "open heaven" through Christ change my prayers and hope?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord Jesus, thank You that You are the stairway between heaven and earth. I cannot climb to God on my own, so I come through You, the open and living way. Amen.
